newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian rupee closes steady at 35.72/73 per dollar.
newsitem.headline: Indian rupee closes steady at 35.72/73 per dollar.

text.p: The Indian rupee closed at 35.72/73 per dollar on Tuesday, almost unchanged from the opening, dealers said.

The dollar was quoted at a high of 35.68 and a low of 35.77 on Tuesday, dealers said. The Reserve Bank of India bought dollars at 35.72/73 levels but the purchases were too small to affect the exchange rate, they said.
The forward dollar premia opened slightly higher, came down and looked up towards the close again on paying pressure, dealers said.
